name: Vipassana Meditation in Bolivia
tradition: Vipassana Meditation as taught by S.N. Goenka
technique: Anapana and Vipassana body-scan meditation, taught in silent, structured residential courses
teacherAccess: No individual teacher access; courses are led by certified Goenka-tradition assistant teachers who give recorded (audio/video) evening discourses and are available for brief questions.
retreatOptions: 10-day courses (the standard offering, held periodically at rented non-center venues around Cochabamba and Santa Cruz de la Sierra); short courses for old students; and, for qualified returning students, longer Satipatthana Sutta courses.
about: Vipassana Meditation in Bolivia is the Bolivian branch of the worldwide Goenka/dhamma.org network, teaching Vipassana in the tradition of Sayagyi U Ba Khin as taught by the late S.N. Goenka. Unlike most countries in the network, Bolivia does not yet have a dedicated, permanently built Dhamma center; courses are instead organized as a dhamma.org 'non-center' location, run periodically at rented retreat venues in and around Cochabamba and Santa Cruz de la Sierra since the country's first course in 1997. The organization offers the standard 10-day residential Vipassana course several times a year — for example, a 10-day course and a longer Satipatthana Sutta course for old students were both scheduled in Cochabamba for September-October 2026 — plus shorter courses for qualified returning students. As with all centers in the Goenka tradition, courses are held under Noble Silence on a fixed daily schedule, taught bilingually in Spanish and English, and offered entirely free of charge, funded solely by voluntary donations from past students. Meals and basic on-site dormitory-style lodging are provided for the full duration of each course.
schedule: No fixed permanent site; 10-day and other adult courses are scheduled periodically through the year at rented venues (e.g. a 10-day course 12-23 Sep 2026 and a Satipatthana Sutta course 26 Sep-4 Oct 2026, both in Cochabamba), announced on the dhamma.org Bolivia course calendar.
cost: No fees of any kind; entirely dana (voluntary donation)-based, with all teaching, food, and lodging given freely and funded by donations from past students who completed a course.

pricePerDay.notes: No suggested amount; a Goenka tradition (dhamma.org) non-center course with no set fee.

foodNotes: All meals prepared and served on-site at no charge for the duration of each course; vegetarian meals included.
workNotes: Old students (those who have completed at least one prior 10-day course) are asked to give some work service (dhamma seva) during their stay; new students are generally not required to work.
